scripts.dev: concurrently --names "GATEWAY,WEB,LOCATION,TRAFFIC,TRAFFIC-UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,blue,magenta,green,yellow" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:location" "npm run dev:traffic" "npm run dev:traffic-ui"
